blocks.text: The Quezon City government on Tuesday advised motorists to take alternate routes as heavy traffic is expected Wednesday during the procession of the image of La Naval de Manila. In an advisory, the local government said heavy traffic is expected from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. as the “recorrido,” or procession route, runs from Metrobank in Commonwealth to the Mother of Divine Providence Parish.
